objects.triage_title: Short-lifetime coefficient laws: thermodynamic limit, planar/3D/4D Bargmann-Fock, fold universality, isotropic spectral moments, D3, triple contact (LS-DER-041..054; LS-DATA-047/048/052/053)
objects.triage_summary: These files derive the closed forms of the leading coefficient: the planar BF value, c3 = 2^(1/6)3^(1/3)(29sqrt6-36)Gamma(1/6)/(432pi^(5/2)), and D3 with the 4D coefficient. They also give the dimension-independent -1/3 law, two-invariant and radial spectral-moment laws with monochromatic minimizers, early side-24 periodization enclosures, and dimension-portable elder selection with triple-contact closure. SymPy sources and results accompany them.
objects.triage_hint: LS-DER-053 reviewed in CL-AUD-LSDER062-20260728-01; LS-DER-046/050 normalization in CL-AUD-LSDER075; no census rows
